gloss: to thin out (plants); to cull; to reduce

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {間引|まび}いていませんでした

definitions.explanation: to remove some seedlings or plants to allow the remaining ones to grow better

definitions.gloss: to reduce; to cut back (services, frequency)
definitions.explanation: to decrease the frequency or number of something

examples.japanese: ⟦{密集|みっしゅう}している→密集する：19630_misshuusuru⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{間引|まび}く。
⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{芽|め}→芽：02141_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{間引|まび}いて⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: Grow daikon by thinning out the sprouts.

examples.japanese: ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{本数|ほんすう}→本数：13154_honsuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{間引|まび}いた。
examples.english: They reduced the number of bus services.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{間引|まび}き{運転|うんてん}→間引き運転：23320_mabikiunten⟧になった。
examples.english: The trains switched to reduced service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{間引|まび}いた。
examples.english: Flights were reduced due to the typhoon.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)

USAGE:
- ⟦{苗|なえ}→苗：05489_nae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{間引|まび}く (to thin seedlings)
- ⟦{運行|うんこう}→運行：14375_unkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{間引|まび}く (to reduce service frequency)
- ⟦{間引|まび}き{運転|うんてん}→間引き運転：23320_mabikiunten⟧ (reduced service operation)

GARDENING:
Thinning allows remaining plants to receive more sunlight, water, and nutrients. The removed seedlings (⟦{間引|まび}き→間引き：21566_mabiki⟧{菜|な}) are often edible.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{剪定|せんてい}→剪定：06327_sentei⟧ (pruning)
- ⟦{摘|つ}む→摘む：02472_tsumu⟧ (to pick, pluck)
- {減便|げんびん} (reduction in services)
